bounded_host_request.command:
v=0
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD | grep -qx 70689ec0fdb9201742625d5d8a0054feeb31320d || v=$((v+1))
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 grep -Fq DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE /app/server/main.js || v=$((v+2))
docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1 | grep -qx true || v=$((v+4))
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health >/dev/null 2>&1 || v=$((v+8))
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 sh -c 'test "$DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE" = model_gates' || v=$((v+16))
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 sh -c 'test "$DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE" = six_role' || v=$((v+32))
for p in 18181 18182 18183 18184; do curl -fsS --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$p/health" >/dev/null 2>&1 || v=$((v+64)); done
docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1 | grep -qx true || v=$((v+128))
